mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it indicates inflationary pressure under a high-interest rate environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of decreasing PAYEMS and rising UNRATE on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% over a quarter and housing starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 5% in the same period, it signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows < 1% and HOUST decreases > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of low GDPC1 growth and declining HOUST on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of increasing INDPRO and decreasing UNRATE on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
